title: Nominations are open for the inaugural AI 100
gist: Bessemer and Newcomer launch the inaugural AI 100 list of private AI companies, announced Nov 12, 2026, with weights favoring market leadership and valuation; cites 2025 benchmarks of AI startup ARR growth and efficiency.

insights.claim: The AI 100 ranks independent private AI companies using four weighted factors: market leadership 35%, estimated valuation 30%, operating metrics 20% and people and culture 15%.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Shows what Bessemer treats as the signal for AI company quality; list publishes Nov 12 at Cerebral Valley AI Summit.

insights.claim: Eligibility spans AI applications, models, infrastructure, compute, security, defense, robotics and physical AI, requiring independence (no majority strategic or PE acquisition and no listing).
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Defines the investable private-AI universe including chips and autonomy hardware.

insights.claim: Per Bessemer's 2025 State of AI report, the fastest AI startups reached about $40 million ARR in their first commercial year and $125 million in the second, with $1.13 million ARR per FTE, four to five times typical SaaS.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Benchmarks for judging AI startup growth and capital efficiency versus SaaS.

insights.claim: Anthropic and OpenAI are growing faster than the Cloud 100 was built to capture, prompting a redesigned list for the AI era.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Frontier labs outgrow legacy software benchmarks.
